name: “Aren’t you afraid of doing things alone??”

lines.ref:
“Aren’t you afraid of doing
things alone??”

Aren’t you afraid of being
dependant on others for the rest
of your life??

shots.brief: sitting alone at a coffee shop or cafe with a drink (ref: Woman sitting by a cafe window holding a mug and smiling, looking outside.; tripod)
walking down a city street alone (ref: Woman walking down a cobblestone European street, looking back and smiling.; filmed by friend)
standing outdoors in the rain with an umbrella (ref: Woman holding an umbrella in the rain in front of a historic building.; tripod)
eating alone at a restaurant (ref: Woman eating dinner solo at a restaurant using chopsticks.; tripod)
holding a coffee cup outdoors or on public transit, selfie (ref: Selfie video on an open-air ferry deck sipping coffee against the sky.; selfie)

audit.notes: Extremely easy to recreate using existing lifestyle b-roll. Any 4–5 clips showing solo activities (cafe working/drinking coffee, walking in NYC streets, solo dining, subway/ferry transit) will work seamlessly with the original audio and text.
audit.summary: A solo lifestyle montage showing various solo activities (coffee shop, walking city streets, dining, ferry ride) with contrasting text questioning the fear of doing things alone.
